description: Default Renovate policy for @benbalter repos: weekly batched updates, a 7-day quarantine on fresh releases, auto-merge for patch/minor and devDependencies, review required for major production bumps, and no digest/SHA pinning.

packageRules.description: Batch GitHub Actions minor/patch bumps into a single PR
Auto-merge devDependencies (they don't ship to users)
Require review for major production-dependency bumps
